corpus_rule: The 31 entries of h-default-corpus.json unchanged, plus the 5 defects named in ledger Entries 31-32. Enumerated before classification. The H-DEFAULT corpus was built for a different hypothesis.
strictness: Criterion 1 requires the distinction to have EXISTED in an upstream representation and been DISCARDED. Information that was never acquired fails criterion 1. Criterion 2 requires a boundary that COLLAPSES two states; a consumer that simply fails to read a distinction which survived fails criterion 2.

entries.upstream: the intermediate node genuinely established no value for the dimension, which is distinct from establishing one
entries.boundary: scope representation stores an unestablished dimension as a missing key, the same as a dimension nobody asked about
entries.downstream: entitled() reads the absence as passable and laundered S1 into S2

entries.upstream: a premise either established a context dimension or did not, and both facts existed at mint time
entries.boundary: the context map represents not-established and not-mentioned identically
entries.downstream: derive filtered absent dimensions out before intersecting, concluding at a world no premise covered

entries.upstream: whether a value was minted by a constructor was known at the moment of minting
entries.boundary: representing that fact as a readable Symbol property maps minted-by-constructor and carries-this-symbol onto one observable
entries.downstream: isAuthority() reconstructs mintedness from the property, and a forged object traced to OWNER

entries.upstream: which producer argued an admission was known when the admission was made
entries.boundary: keying the registry by dimension NAME collapses admitted-by-pytest and admitted-by-git
entries.downstream: the registry decides governance from the key, so a pytest-argued dimension governed git records

entries.upstream: reserved keys were distinguishable from user keys in the admission path
entries.boundary: the admissibility check treats every key alike once admitted
entries.downstream: comparison manufactured NOT_COMPARABLE from the reserved key

entries.upstream: a carried value existed and was shadowed, which differs from never having been carried
entries.boundary: shadowing removed it, leaving the same representation as absence
entries.downstream: consumers read the absence as nothing having been carried

entries.upstream: a claim about S1 and a claim about S2 are different claims and both scopes existed
entries.boundary: the node identity key excluded scope, mapping both onto one id
entries.downstream: add() decided they were the same node and moved the referent under existing dependents

entries.upstream: the same content had several distinct production histories, each known when produced
entries.boundary: the ledger keyed provenance by digest, keeping one binding per digest
entries.downstream: provenance lookups reconstruct history from content and returned the last binding

entries.why: the relevance of a pending item was never established in any upstream representation, so no boundary discarded it. Information that was never acquired is not information that was lost.

entries.upstream: whether a block is terminal is a fact about the block, known independently of how it was reached
entries.boundary: measuring terminality by PATH maps terminal-by-nature and terminal-on-this-path onto one value
entries.downstream: attainment reconstructed terminality, and a regenerated external.json would have flipped it

entries.upstream: the refuter was established at S2 and the claim was about S1, and both scopes existed
entries.boundary: the REFUTES edge carried no scope, so refuters at any world looked alike
entries.downstream: validity was computed from the edge and a claim about S1 was refuted at S2

entries.upstream: the identity of a node encodes its scope, so the old and new scope were distinguishable
entries.boundary: reestablish() took a scope argument without consulting the identity it was rewriting
entries.downstream: the node's scope was rewritten under an identity that still claimed the old one

entries.upstream: the staleness of a witness was known when it was recorded
entries.boundary: the execution-edge representation carries no staleness, so stale and fresh edges are identical
entries.downstream: scoring read the edge and credited ADVANCEMENT

entries.upstream: a metric was measured or it was not, and which was true was known at measurement time
entries.boundary: the frontier representation stores unmeasured and equal identically
entries.downstream: Pareto comparison read the unmeasured metric as EQUIVALENT and kept a candidate on the frontier

entries.upstream: the producer version was absent, which differs from a version whose text is undefined
entries.boundary: string concatenation maps an absent field and the literal text onto one criterion string
entries.downstream: criterion comparison treated pytest undefined as an established criterion

entries.upstream: an IMPORT_FAILED record established no document and no ordinal, and the failure was known
entries.boundary: the record shape gives every record a document and an ordinal slot
entries.downstream: identity was reconstructed from those slots, using an ARRAY INDEX as an ordinal

entries.upstream: which producer actually produced a record was known at production time
entries.boundary: the adapter matched on the producer WORD, collapsing distinct producers that share a name
entries.downstream: doctest semantics were granted to any producer whose word matched

entries.upstream: a grantee either requested no restriction or requested the empty world, and the caller knew which
entries.boundary: an omitted context argument and an empty context object become the same request
entries.downstream: delegate reconstructed the intended world and handed a grant over S1 to every world

entries.upstream: whether a dimension was established was known before narrowing was requested
entries.boundary: the narrowing request represents an absent dimension the same as one being narrowed
entries.downstream: narrow() moved an established world under restriction's free pass

entries.why: the token's KIND was present, carried and readable the whole way; nothing collapsed EPISTEMIC and NORMATIVE onto one representation. commit() simply did not consult a distinction that had survived. A consumer failing to read is not a boundary destroying.

both premises' kinds and grants were present and distinguishable; derive read premises[0]. Argument order determined the answer, which is an incidental property choosing semantics - leakage, not loss. Nothing was erased.

entries.upstream: the operation refused, which is a different event from producing an output with no coordinates
entries.boundary: a refusal object and an output with empty coordinates read identically to the probe
entries.downstream: the probe read every coordinate as changed and produced a confident ALL_OF

entries.upstream: came-from-outside-the-inputs and survived-losing-every-input are different facts about support
entries.boundary: both were recorded as no single input affects it
entries.downstream: the label UNSUPPORTED was reconstructed from that one representation

entries.upstream: a probe either could not measure or measured an absence, and the run knew which
entries.boundary: both were returned as a bare undefined
entries.downstream: the dependency matrix reconstructed meaning from that undefined

entries.why: which fact supports which output coordinate was never captured by any upstream representation - that relation is exactly what lineage existed to discover. The strip assumed name equality in place of a distinction that had never been acquired.

entries.upstream: a baseline that produced a readable authority output differs from one that refused, and both were observed
entries.boundary: the comparison read both sides through a coordinate projection that is empty for either
entries.downstream: two empty projections compared equal and were scored OBSERVED with no delta

entries.upstream: a world that could not be constructed differs from one constructed identically, and the attempt knew which
entries.boundary: the decode failure path returned the same result as an unchanged argument
entries.downstream: PERTURBATION_NO_EFFECT was reconstructed from that shared representation

entries.upstream: both the inner producer and the validating wrapper returned the value, and both calls were recorded
entries.boundary: byResult kept ONE producer per object identity, discarding the outer one
entries.downstream: replay reconstructed the value through the inner call and silently skipped the wrapper's refusal

entries.upstream: the DAG distinguishes nodes that were constructed and handed in from the target's own arguments
entries.boundary: the group set was taken as nodes carrying leaves, collapsing premises with the operation's own facts
entries.downstream: the support formula was inferred over that set, making ALL_OF structurally unreachable

entries.upstream: ANY is an explicit value in production meaning licenses anything, and it was present in the observed call
entries.boundary: the translation into a calculus context has no wildcard, so ANY and a specific value both become a context value
entries.downstream: the comparison reconstructed a verdict and produced 965 accusations against working code

entries.upstream: two scopes with equal structure and different object references were distinguishable as structures
entries.boundary: the specification compares context values with strict inequality, which reads references not worlds
entries.downstream: identical scopes were refused and the refusal was read as a disagreement

entries.upstream: the child process either ran and produced nothing or died before producing anything, and the runtime knew
entries.boundary: an exit code of 0 with empty stdout represents both
entries.downstream: I read the empty output as a completed run with no findings

entries.upstream: the stack contained real ESM frames naming real production files
entries.boundary: the frame pattern could not read file:///C:/ and the unreadable lines were dropped, leaving the same empty list as a stack with no production frames
entries.downstream: reachability was reconstructed from the empty list as PRODUCTION_REACHED 0

entries.why: the aggregate-of-private-bindings structure was present in the AST throughout and was never collapsed with anything; the rule simply consulted a different feature, the consumer count. Choosing the wrong evidence is not a boundary destroying a distinction.

entries.upstream: a stack line that failed to parse is a frame that exists and was not read, which differs from a frame that is not there
entries.boundary: frames() dropped unparsed lines, so a path with a hole and a complete path had identical representations
entries.downstream: reachability verdicts were issued over 676 paths with holes in them

entries.why: every enclosing function was present in the index the whole time; the rule asked only the innermost. The distinction survived and the query was wrong, which is not a lossy boundary.
